Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! We can see the South Africa players in a huddle, and now they are taking their respective field positions. The two openers for India are their skipper, Shikhar Dhawan and Shubman Gill. South Africa going with spin straightaway as Bjorn Fortuin is ready to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, South Africa have put on 278 runs on the board and with their bowling attack it will not be an easy chase for India. The top order of the hosts will need to put on a better performance and Shikhar Dhawan and Shubman Gill will be key for them. This is a must-win game for them and they will be confident enough to level the series. Will the Men in Blue gun this total down? Or will the Proteas defend it successfully to seal the series? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Reeza Hendricks is up for a chat. He says that it was nice to be out there and contribute but would have liked to get that ton. Adds that it was nice batting with Aiden Markram and they needed that partneship but unfortunately, both of them got out at the wrong time and they couldn't quite get the big finish either. Says that if one of them had stayed on, they would have got to 300. Mentions that the Indian bowlers bowled well and it was a tricky wicket as the ball wasn't quite coming onto the bat.

The India bowling effort was hot and cold throughout the innings. Mohammed Siraj gave them the perfect start when he got rid of Quinton de Kock in the third over and then the others put the brakes on the runs before Shahbaz Ahmed got the wicket of Janneman Malan which was his maiden ODI wicket. They could not continue the momentum and let South Africa a build a huge partnership. However, they got back in the game with the help of Siraj once again who broke the partnership and got the wicket of Hendricks. India then further got control over the game when Kuldeep Yadav dismissed Klassen and Washington Sundar got the big wicket of Markram in consecutive overs. Mohammed Siraj was the pick of the bowlers with three wickets for just 38 runs in his 10 overs. They bowled well in the death overs for a change and did not let the South African finishers to score big. India will be happy to restrict South Africa under the 300-run mark.

South Africa will be satisfied with their performance with the blade but they know they could have got more. They did not get the best of starts and lost Quinton de Kock and Janneman Malan inside the first Powerplay for cheap scores. After that Aiden Markram and Reeza Hendricks started steadying the ship, they both started off slow and took time to settle in but once they did they scored runs freely. Both of them added a 129 runs before Hendricks got dismissed for a well played 74. However, Markram continued the momentum with Heinrich Klaasen and both played some lusty blows but both of them perished in the space of two overs and gave the momentum back to India. David Miller stayed till the end but struggled to score big runs. They will feel that they are 20-25 runs short as there will be dew when India will come out to chase.

A really good bowling performance from India at the back end of the innings and they have restricted South Africa to 278. They will be the slightly happier side going into the break and the momentum will also be with them after the incredible final over from Mohammed Siraj, but they will also be wary of the fiery African bowling attack.

Leg bye! Just 3 runs off the final over, a brilliant finish from Mohammed Siraj. He bowls this on a hard length and angles it into the body. Bjorn Fortuin gets cramped for room as he looks for the pull. The ball hits the thigh pads and rolls away towards cover. They get a leg bye and South Africa finish with 278/7 on the board.
Bjorn Fortuin is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! What a final over this is turning out to be by Mohammed Siraj! Siraj bowls this quicker and fuller. The ball just tails in a bit from around the off pole. Keshav Maharaj backs away and looks to swing it hard across the line. The pace is just too much to handle for Maharaj and the ball goes on to knock the off stump out of the ground. Siraj picks up his third and this has been a brilliant fightback by India in the final few overs.
This is poor cricket from Keshav Maharaj. Slower and fuller, outside off, Maharaj tries to attempt the reverse-scoop over short third man but can't get bat on ball.

Excellent bowling! Mohammed Siraj sees David Miller advancing and bowls a short ball, pushing it outside off as well. Miller has to drag the pull and only manages to hit it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length and outside off, Keshav Maharaj looks to pull but gets it off the toe end of the bat towards backward point for a single. This gets David Miller back on strike.
Swing and a miss! Fullish length, around off and tailing back in a bit. Keshav Maharaj hangs back and has a swing across the line but misses the ball.
Mohammed Siraj (9-0-36-2) to bowl the last over.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries now! Pitched up, in the slot and David Miller is able to swing across the line and gets it well in front of mid-wicket to pick up a boundary.
FOUR! Finally, David Miller is able to get one away. Full and straight, Miller steps out and thumps is right back over the bowler's head. The ball goes hard and flat and into the fence.
Thakur gets it in the blockhole, on middle and leg but Maharaj manages to flick it away past square leg for a run.
Slower one, bowled on a length and pushed well outside off. Miller taps it towards sweeper cover for yet another single.
On a hard length, around off, Maharaj hits it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Full and on leg stump, David Miller advances and whips it away to deep square leg for just a single. Miller feels he should have done with that one and rightly so.
Good length, around the hips and this is tucked away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A low full toss and on off, Keshav Maharaj slices it towards extra cover for a single.
A slower one, full and on middle, Keshav Maharaj works it with the inner half towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a good length and on off, shaping in a bit, Keshav Maharaj looks to play at it but misses.

FOUR BYES! Now, what happened here? Mohammed Siraj has a shy at the stumps which costs four overthrows and the umpire signals a boundary. Siraj and the Indian players don't seem pleased but there was an attempt from Siraj to run-out Miller at the non-striker's end. The issue raised here by the Indians is that the ball was thrown back by the keeper and should be dead but the attempt of a run-out makes the ball live and hence, it will be a boundary. Poor cricket this from Siraj.
Misses the leg stump by a whisker! Pace on from Siraj, angling it in from around middle and there's just a hint of reverse on this occasion. Maharaj backs away looking to drive but is well beaten.

Ouch, that must have hurt! Hard length, on middle and leg and just jagging back in. Miller looks for the slog but misses and gets a blow around the rib cage. Terrific over by Thakur, just a single and a wicket off it.

Is there a bat on it? No, there isn't! This is a lovely delivery by Shardul Thakur, fuller and in that channel around off. David Miller looks to drive but the ball holds its line and beats the inside edge. The keeper, Sanju Samson seems excited and appeals for a caught behind but the umpire turns it down. Shikhar Dhawan does take the review. The third umpire checks UltraEdge and finds a flatline as the ball passes the bat and the review is wasted by India.
Good length, around off, pushed out onto the off side for a single.
Almost chops it on! Pace on this time, around the top of off, Keshav Maharaj looks to dab at it but gets a bottom edge that goes past the stumps and towards the keeper.
Keshav Maharaj walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! The pressure was mounting and Shardul Thakur gets the breakthrough for India. This is once again bowled slower but on a hard length and pushed outside off. Wayne Parnell is way too early in his shot and can't quite adjust. In the end, Parnell just ends up chipping it down towards wide long off where Shreyas Iyer takes a simple catch. Thakur strikes in his comeback over and South Africa just unable to finish with a flourish here.
Commentary.Howout: c Shreyas Iyer b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Swing and a miss! Thakur rolls his fingers over the ball and slants it across Parnell, who lines up for the slog and ends up missing it.
Shardul Thakur (3-0-23-0) is back on.
On a good length and over middle, Wayne Parnell stays back and just chips it down to long off for one more. Only 4 runs off the over and it's now been 25 balls since the last boundary.
Around the top of off, Miller opens the face of the bat and hits it towards deep point for one.

The change up now and this is excellent bowling by Mohammed Siraj. Miller charges down the pitch but Siraj bowls a slower short ball over off stump. Miller tries to cut it away but is undone by the lack of pace.
Leg bye! Just a touch fuller now and at the pads, Wayne Parnell looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the pads and rolls towards short third man as the batters get a leg bye.
Good length again, over middle and leg, this is muscled off the toe end of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Hard length, around off and angling away. David Miller hangs deep and looks to pull but is well beaten.
Another short delivery, on off, David Miller goes on his back foot and pulls it towards long on for a single.
Short and on off, Wayne Parnell pushes it towards extra cover for a run.

Tossed up, short and on off, Wayne Parnell smashes it wide of long off where Shreyas Iyer covers his ground quickly and dives to his right to make a one-handed stop to save the boundary. Two runs taken!
Flatter, short and on off, David Miller moves back and punches it towards deep point for one.
Short again and on off, Wayne Parnell forces it towards long off for a run.
Quicker, short and outside off, angling in, David Miller cuts it towards deep point for a single.
A slower one, on a length and on leg, David Miller works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Swing and a miss! Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a hard length and outside off, angling away, David Miller looks to pull it but misses it completely.
Short of a length and on off, Wayne Parnell slaps it towards long on for just a run.
Mohammed Siraj bowls this on hard length and on middle, Wayne Parnell looks to pull it away but gets hurried and bottom edge it onto his body.
WIDE! Mohammed Siraj bowls the slower bouncer, on off, Wayne Parnell leaves it alone. It is called a wide. Mohammed Siraj is not happy as it looked inside the wide line.
This is on a hard length and outside off, David Miller cuts it off his back foot towards deep point for a run.
A slower one, on a length and on middel, Wayne Parnell tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Mohammed Siraj (6-1-26-2) is back on.
A single to end his over as this short delivery is cut away towards deep point by Parnell. Only 3 runs from the over!
Shortish and on off, David Miller drags it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Washington Sundar continues to bowl short, on off, David Miller cuts it straight to cover.
Another short delivery, on off, Wayne Parnell moves back and slaps it down to long off for a single.
Shorter in length and on off, Wayne Parnell once again finds the fielder at cover.
Tossed up, full and on off, Wayne Parnell pushes it towards cover.
Floated, full and on leg, David Miller blocks it to the leg side.
FOUR! SMASHED! This is short and outside off, tuning further away, David Miller reaches for it and generates some power to hit wide of long off for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on off, Wayne Parnell taps it in front of point for a quick single.
BEAUTY! Kuldeep Yadav bowls the googly now, short and on middle, turning in sharply, Wayne Parnell looks to blocks it out but misses and gets hit on the gloves.
Slower through the air, full and on leg, David Miller flicks it through square leg for a run.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off, Wayne Parnell smashes it wide of long off for just a single.
Kuldeep Yadav (8-0-42-1) is back on for probably his final spell.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is pushed down to long off by Parnell.
Short again and around off, David Miller punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Short and  outside off, David Miller moves back and cuts it wide of deep point for a couple of runs.
Flatter, full and on off, David Miller mistimes his shot towards the bowler.
FOUR! Cheeky from Miller! This is floated, full and on leg, David Miller goes down and scoops it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on off, Wayne Parnell drives it towards long off for a single.
Powerplay 3! Now, fives fielders are allowed outside the circle till the last over.
Full and wide, driven towards the man at sweeper cover for yet another single.
Around the hips, Miller works it past square leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller and outside off, eased away towards sweeper cover for a single.

A direct hit and Wayne Parnell would have been struggling. Length, around off, Miller just nudges it past backward point and sets off for the run. Shreyas Iyer moves to his right and has a shy at the batter's end but misses. The replays show that Parnell wasn't even in the frame.
Hits the deck hard now and bowls it around off, MIller stays back and punches it out on the off side.
Avesh Khan comes from around the wicket and serves a shortish delivery around middle. David Miller tucks it away towards mid-wicket.
Avesh Khan (6-0-31-0) repalces Kuldeep Yadav.
Around off, this is stroked away through covers for a single and David Miller is off the mark.
Length, at the stumps and David Miller just blocks it out.
Tossed up, full and on off, David Miller blocks it towards extra cover.

Short and on leg, Wayne Parnell tucks it towards short fine leg, David Miller calls for the run and sets off but Parnell hesitates a bit and then starts to run. Kuldeep Yadav has a shy at the bowler's end but misses and the batters compete the run.
Wayne Parnell is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Very soft dismissal and Aiden Markram is distraught with himself. This is short and outside off from Washington Sundar, there to be hit. Markram backs away and goes a bit too hard at it. Markram loses his shape a bit and ends up reaching for it. The ball is hit hard and flat to the left of xtra cover where Shikhar Dhawan takes a good low catch diving to his left. Markram departs after a good knock and India now have the opening they were looking for.
Commentary.Howout: c Shikhar Dhawan b Washington Sundar

Commentary.Commentary: Naging length, on off and punched off the back foot straight towards extra cover.
David Miller is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! A really good catch in the deep and Kuldeep Yadav gets his man. Kuldeep holds this one back and serves it on a length and down the leg side. Heinrich Klaasen pre-meditates and walks past the leg stump. Klaasen looks to go over long off again but is early in his shot and the ball turns in as well. The ball goes off the toe end of the bat and over mid on. Mohammed Siraj from long on races in and takes a brilliant tumbling catch just inches off the ground. Klaasen departs after a quick start and South Africa lose their fourth.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammed Siraj b Kuldeep Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, this is nudged away behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
SIX! Klaasen showing his class! Flighted delivery, on middle, Heinrich Klaasen steps out and smokes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
On a nagging length and around off, Markram goes on the back foot and eases it towards long off for a single.
Fraction shorter and on middle, this is pulled down to deep square leg for one more.
Tosses it up full and on leg stump, Markram drives it down to long on for a run.
Length, around the top of off and this is dabbed straight towards point.
Full and straight, this is pushed away towards mid on.
Banged in short and over off, Klaasen pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Fuller length this time, angling into off, Klaasen defends it out from his crease.
FOUR! Picked up and dispatched! Short of a length, on middle and leg, Heinrich Klaasen plays the short-arm pull and hammers it into the mid-wicket fence.
Good length, outside off and this is sliced away to the right of third man for a single.
Avesh Khan comes back into the attack. He has conceded 24 runs in his 5 overs.
This is dragged down by Kuldeep Yadav and around leg stump. Heinrich Klaasen rocks back and pulls it to the left of deep square leg where Shahbaz Ahmed tidies up and keeps it down to a couple.
On a length and around off, Aiden Markram strokes it off the back foot and down to long off for yet another single.
Around middle, Klaasen plays it inside-out through extra cover for a run.
Slower, on a length and turning in from leg stump. Heinrich Klaasen makes room and hits is straight to the man at extra cover.
Nagging length, on off, Heinrich Klaasen keeps it out off the back foot.
Tossed up, full and on off stump, Aiden Markram drives it down to long off for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav is brought back into the attack. He has gone for 26 runs in his 6 overs so far.
Darted full and on leg, Aiden Markram works it towards long on for a run. 11 runs from this over and Shahbaz Ahmed finishes his spell with 1 wicket for 54 runs on his debut.
Short again and on off, Aiden Markram knocks it towards covers.
Quicker one, short and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen cuts it towards deep point for a single.

SIX! BANG! Heinrich Klaasen has sent this into the stands! Shahbaz Ahmed bowls this a touch fuller, on leg, Heinrich Klaasen clears his front leg and uses his bottom hand to smoke it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A bit short and on off, Aiden Markram moves back and pushes it towards covers where Shikhar Dhawan dives and half-stops it. They cross.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Aiden Markram skips down the track and drills it hard wide of long on for a brace.
Shahbaz Ahmed (9-0-43-1) comes back in to finish his spell.
Make that five dots! Mohammed Siraj pulls his length back a bit and on off, Heinrich Klaasen dabs it towards point. Only a single from the over, a couple of terrific overs from Siraj on the trot.
Four dots on the trot! This is full and on off, Heinrich Klaasen strokes it towards mid off.
Mohammed Siraj bangs in short delivery, on off, Heinrich Klaasen looks for the pull shot but hits it from the bottom half and it deflects onto his body.
Fuller in length and around off, Heinrich Klaasen drives it but straight to extra cover.
A slower one now, full and on middle, Heinrich Klaasen mistimes his flick towards mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Aiden Markram drives it down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Nicely timed but a poor delivery once again from Sundar. He bowls this flatter, short and down the leg, Heinrich Klaasen stays there and tucks it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. 11 runs from the over!
Short again and on leg, Aiden Markram moves back and slaps it down to long on for a run.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! This is short and outside off, Aiden Markram quickly moves onto his back foot and cuts it towards the vacant deep point fence for a boundary.
Floated, full and outside off, Heinrich Klaasen moves across and scoops it towards fine leg for a run.
Looped up and around middle, Aiden Markram uses his feet and eases it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Aiden Markram blocks it back to the bowler.
Four dots to end the over then! This is on a length and around off, Heinrich Klaasen guides it towards point. End of a successful over for India!
Three dots in a row! Mohammed Siraj serves this full and on middle, Heinrich Klaasen knocks it towards mid on and denies for the run straightaway.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Heinrich Klaasen taps it towards point.
This is full and on off, Heinrich Klaasen drives it towards mid off.

Drinks break! A 129-run stand between Reeza Hendricks and Aiden Markram has just been broken and India will be a bit relieved now. Hendricks was going great guns and Markram too was giving him great support. They have laid the foundation for South Africa to get a big score on the board. But will this wicket change the momentum of the innings? We'll find out as a fascinating passage of play awaits. Also, Heinrich Klaasen walks in at number 5 for South Africa.

OUT! TAKEN! The decision to bring Siraj back into the attack has worked in favour of India. Siraj gets his second wicket and finally breaks this dangerous partnership. He bowls this short of a length and on middle and leg, Reeza Hendricks goes for the pull shot but his bat turns in his hand when he connects with the ball.  As a result, Hendricks fails to get elavation and the ball goes flat and in the air towards deep square leg where Shahbaz Ahmed takes a good catch running to his left. Reeza Hendricks though has done his job but he will be disappointed not to get to that ton. South Africa three down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Shahbaz Ahmed b Mohammed Siraj

Commentary.Commentary: Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a hard length and on off, Aiden Markram moves back and punches it towards mid off for a single.
Mohammed Siraj (4-1-24-1) is back into the attack.
Looped up, full and on off, Aiden Markram reverse sweeps with the inner half towards short third man for a run. 11 runs from the over!
SIX! BANG! Aiden Markram clears the fence this time. This is flatter and quicker but down the leg, Aiden Markram goes down and slogs it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Aiden Markram goes for the reverse sweep but hits it straight towards short third man.
Floated, short and on leg, Reeza Hendricks clears his front leg but mistimes his pull shot towards dee mid-wciekt for a run.
Flatter, short and around leg, Reeza Hendricks tucks it with soft hands towards deep square leg and Avesh Khan there is a bit late to react. Two runs taken!
Shorter in length and on leg, Aiden Markram flicks it off his back foot through square leg for a single.
Just a fraction short and outside off, this is tapped away through covers for a single.
Length ball, on middle and leg, this is flicked away through square leg for a run.
FOUR! Goes through the hands! Short and wide, Reeza Hendricks slaps it away towards deep point. Ishan Kishan speeds to his left and does well to get to it but fumbles and Hendricks gets the boundary.
Just a touch fuller and on off, Reeza Hendricks defends it out towards short cover.
Around the top of off, this is tapped away towards point.
Fuller and angling down leg, Markram looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls away towards mid-wicket and a single is taken.

FOUR! Stand and deliver! This is floated up, around off, Reeza Hendricks stands tall and just uses his wrists to hammer it over extra cover for a boundary. 150 is up for South Africa and these two looking to take the game away from India at the moment.
This is angled into middle, Hendricks nudges it leg side.
Fuller this time, quicker too and around off, Markram slices it past point for one more.
Quicker one, close to the off pole. Hendricks plays it with an angled bat in front of point for a quick run.
On middle and just turning away a touch, Reeza Hendricks solidly keeps it out.
Floated up on off stump, Aiden Markram backs away and strokes it towards deep cover for a single.
Shahbaz Ahmed (8-0-36-1) replaces Kuldeep Yadav.
Goes fuller now Avesh and serves it around middle, Hendricks defends it back to the bowler.
Good length, over middle and this is tucked away towards square leg.

FOUR! Reeza Hendricks is looking very dangerous now and the 100-run stand also comes up between these two. Another short ball, outside off, Hendricks pulls it away off the meat of the bat and well in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.
Aiden Markram does get to FIFTY eventually and he will be hoping to kick on now. Full and straight, driven off the inside edge down to short fine leg for a single.

This is banged in short by Avesh Khan, at a good height and around off. markram looks to pull but takes his eyes off the ball and seems to have missed. There is a loud appeal though and the finger is raised. Aiden Markram has reviewed it. The third umpire checks the UltraEdge thoroughly and finds that there is no bat involved and the on-field decision is reversed.
Length ball, angling in from around middle, Markram punches it towards mid on.
Avesh Khan (3-0-12-0) is back on.
Nicely flighted, outside off and Hendricks defends it off the front foot.
Missed opportunity! This is dragged down around the pads, Reeza Hendricks rocks back and pulls it straight to the man at square leg.
Flighted, around off and this is driven down to long off for one.
Nagging length, on middle and turning in sharply. Aiden Markram goes on the back foot and just about manages to keep it out.
On the pads, flicked away towards mid-wicket where a misfield allows an easy single to the batters.

SIX! Just over! This is tossed up on leg stump and turning in. Reeza Hendricks picks it up and swings with the spin. The ball goes high and just over a leaping Ishan Kishan at the cow corner fence. First maximum of the innings this.
Slower and shorter around off, Markram hops back and dabs it down towards backward point.
Eased away and that will be FIFTY for Reeza Hendricks, a classy inning so far from him. This is short and outside off, cut away to deep point for one.
A hint of flight, around middle and leg and this is eased down to long off for a single.
A yorker now, on off stump and Markram just jams it out.
Deft touch now. Flatter, close to the off stump and Markram just nudges it past short third man. Washington Sundar over there does well to chase it down and save a couple of runs for his team.
FOUR! Glorious from Aiden Markram. A half-volley around off, Markram leans in and drives it beautifully through the cover-region to find the boundary.
Short again and on leg, Reeza Hendricks flicks it towards square leg.
Flighted delivery, short and on off, turning in sharply, Reeza Hendricks manages to keep it out towards the left of mid on where the fielder dives to stop the ball.
Shorter in length and around off, Aiden Markram goes on his back foot and pushes it towards long off for one.
Nicely tossed up, full and on middle, Aiden Markram solidly blocks it from his front foot.
Flatter, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks leans on and tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! What a shot! Even the bowler is surprised by it. Kuldeep Yadav tosses it up, full and on off, Reeza Hendricks goes inside out and chips it towards the deep extra cover fence for a boundary.
Oh..that is close! Shahbaz Ahmed bowls this quicker, short and around off, Aiden Markram looks to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge. It was inches away from taking the edge.
Fires this one full and on off, Aiden Markram plays it towards mid off.
Gives it some air this time, on leg, Reeza Hendricks eases it towards long on for one more.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Aiden Markram drives it with the inner half towards long on for a run.
Flatter, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks makes room and strokes it towards deep point for a single.
Looped up, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks knocks it back to the bowler.
Shahbaz Ahmed comes back in to replace Shardul Thakur.
Another short delivery, on middle, Aiden Markram gets cramped for room and pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length and outside off, Aiden Markram cuts it hard but cannot beat the fielder at covers who dives to his left to stop it.
Flighted delivery, full and on the pads, Reeza Hendricks works it away towards deep square leg for a single. The fielders there has a bit of miscommunication but no harm done.
Shortish and around leg, turning in, Aiden Markram makes room and slaps it down to long on for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Aiden Markram goes on his back foot and blocks it out.
Tossed up, short and on middle, turning in, Reeza Hendricks moves back and tucks it towards deep square leg for a single.
Kuldeep Yadav (3-0-9-0) is back on.
Pulls his length back a bit and around off, Aiden Markram punches it off his back foot towards point. 10 runs from the over!

FOUR! Classic shot from Markram! Shardul Thakur continues with the fuller length, on middle, this time, Aiden Markram drives it nicely down the ground and past the diving long on fielder for a boundary. With that, the 100 comes up for South Africa as well.
On a length and around off, Reeza Hendricks dabs it towards backward point and sets off for the run, the fielder has a shy at the batter's end but misses and the batter is safe.
FOUR! Great shot! Shardul Thakur serves this fuller and on the pads this time, Reeza Hendricks stays there and wristily clips it away towards the vacant deep mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Full again and on middle, Aiden Markram drives it towards mid on for a quick single.
Full and around the leg stump line, Aiden Markram strokes it towards short mid-wicket.
BEATEN! This quicker, short and around off, Reeza Hendricks looks to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge. 9 runs from the over!

FOUR! Reeza Hendricks gets into the act now! Washington Sundar flights this up and on off with mid off up in the ring, Reeza Hendricks stays there and lofts it towards the long off fence for a boundary.
A bit short and around off, Aiden Markram taps it towards cover-point for a run.
Slower through he air, on middle, Aiden Markram leans on and blocks it out.
FOUR! A lovely shot from Markram! This is floated, full and around leg, Aiden Markram leans on and gently drills it down the ground and wide of long on for a boundary.
Tossed up, full and on off, Aiden Markram skips down the track and hits it hard but straight to mid off.
Good length, around leg, and played on the up, down to long on for a single.

FOUR! Beautiful stroke and Aiden Markram is getting into his stride now. Fullish delivery, on off and driven on the up through wide mid off for a boundary. The 50-run partnership comes up between these two as well.
Thakur keeps angling it onto the pads and it is just easy at the moment for the batters to mil the single. This is tucked away 'round the corner by Hendricks for one more.
Length again, on the pads, Markram backs away and hits it to the right of mid on for a quick single.
Angling onto the pads, flicked away by Reeza Hendricks towards deep square leg for a single.
Good length, around off, this is firmly punched on the up but straight to the man at cover.
FOUR! Cheeky but effective! Length, around middle and off, Aiden Markram gets inside the line of the ball and just scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Flatter delivery, close to the off stump, Reeza Hendricks taps it through cover-point for one more.
Just a fraction shorter and outside off, Markram cuts it away to deep cover-point for a single.
Around off, Markram drives it straight towards mid off.
Fullish length, on middle and leg and this is once again worked off the back foot towards square leg.
On a nagging length and on off, Aiden Markram goes on the back foot and plays it out on the leg side.
Washington Sundar comes back into the attack. He conceded just 2 runs in his first over.
Thakur serves it full and on leg stump, Reeza Hendricks uses his wrists to whip it away towards wide long on for a brace.
Good length, around middle and this is nicely punched away down to long on for a single.
Back of a length, on off stump, Markram punches it out towards mid off. this time.
Pitched up, at the stumps and this is punched away towards mid on.

Straight through the hands. This is full and straight, driven to the left of mid on where Mohammed Siraj misses the ball and allows the batters to pick up a couple of runs. The bowler won't be pleased with that effort.
Thakur starts off with a length ball, slanting into the pads, Markram keeps it out on the leg side.

Drinks break! The Indian bowlers have done well till now especially their spinners. Shahbaz Ahmed looked really good and also got his maiden ODI wicket. South Africa are going at slow rate but Reeza Hendricks is now set and will look to bat deep along with Aiden Markram. India will try to break this partnership as quickly as possible. An exciting session of cricket awaits us. Also, Shardul Thakur to bowl after the break.
Short again and on leg, Aiden Markram moves back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
A googly now, looped up, short and outside off, turning away, Aiden Markram fails to pick it and goes for the cut but gets an inside edge onto his pads as the ball dies on the pitch.

This is nicely tossed up around leg stump and turning into the right-hander. Aiden Markram gets in position to sweep but misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is another huge appeal for lbw and Kuldeep Yadav is certain that it is out. The umpire doesn't agree though and Shikhar Dhawan does take the review yet again. UltraEdge builds up and shows that there is no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is pitching in line but the wickets are umpire's call and the on-field call will stand. India don't lose the review though and Markram survives.
Quicker this time, on middle and leg, Markram just about keeps it out.
Slower up on a length and around middle, Reeza Hendricks waits for it and wrists it through mid-wicket for one.
Flighted full and around off, it is the wrong 'un. Reeza Hendricks plays it with the turn and towards covers.
Excellent running! Good length around middle, pushed away towards mid on for a quick single. 10 runs off the over, a good one for South Africa.
FOUR! A real freebie from Siraj now. Attempted yorker, going down leg, Reeza Hendricks just tickles it into the fine leg fence for another boundary.
A bit slower and fuller, outside off, this is just strokes away past point for a run.
FOUR! Put away! An attempted bouncer by Siraj, over middle. Aiden Markram gets on top of the bounce and pulls it away into the square leg fence.
Around the top of off, Markram looks to play this one on the up but ends up punching it back onto the deck.
Siraj starts off with a fuller one on off stump, Aiden Markram pushes straight back to the bowler.
Mohammed Siraj (3-1-14-1) is brought back into the attack.
Shorter in length and on middle, Aiden Markram goes back and bunts it onto the ground and the bounce takes it over Kuldeep Yadav towards long on. A single is taken.
Looped up, full and on off, Aiden Markram goes on his back foot and blocks it onto the pitch.
Darted full and down the leg =, Reeza Hendricks works it through square leg for a run.
A bit short and around off, Aiden Markram goes back and plays it towards long off for a run.
BEAUTY! Kuldeep Yadav flights this up and around off, straightens after hitting the deck, Aiden Markram looks to block it out but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tossed up, short and on off, turning away, Aiden Markram punches it towards covers.
Quicker, full and on middle, keeps low, Reeza Hendricks looks to cut it close from his body but gets hurried a but does well to keep it out towards point.
Looped up and around off, Aiden Markram eases it down to long off for another run.
Shahbaz Ahmed bowls this short and around off, Reeza Hendricks moves back and knocks it towards mid off for a quick single.
Flighted delivery, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks pushes it back to the bowler.
Flatter, full and on off, Reeza Hendricks drills it but straight towards short covers.
Tossed up, full and on off, Aiden Markram drives it down to long off for a single.
Short again and around off, turning away a bit, keeps low again, Reeza Hendricks checks his shot at the last moment and punches it wide of long off for a brace.
Shortish and outside off, Reeza Hendricks cuts it but straight to point.
Looped up, short and on off, turning away, keeps low, Aiden Markram reaches for it and forces it towards long off for a run.
Kuldeep Yadav lands this a bit short and on middle, Reeza Hendricks flicks it through square leg for a single.
Floated, full and around off, Reeza Hendricks leans on and strokes it towards covers.
Kuldeep Yadav starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks blocks it back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends now as Kuldeep Yadav has been handed the ball.
Another single as this short delivery is worked down to long off by Hendricks.
Shorter in length and on middle, Aiden Markram pushes it off the back foot towards long on for a one.
Floated, full and on middle, Aiden Markram blocks it out.
Quicker, full and on middle, keeps low too, Reeza Hendricks does well to get his bat down and hits it towards long off for a run.
FOUR! Nice placement! Shahbaz Ahmed tosses it up, full and around leg, Reeza Hendricks stays there and just lofts it away towards the vacant wide long on fence for a boundary.
Short and on middle, Aiden Markram goes on his back foot and slaps it down to long on for a single.
Shahbaz Ahmed to continue his spell as Avesh Khan is seen walking off the pitch, maybe for a bit of rehydration.
A slower one now, on a length and on middle, Reeza Hendricks knocks it back to the bowler. Only 2 runs from the over then.
Short of a length and on middle, Aiden Markram pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sharp bouncer! Avesh Khan bangs in a bouncer and on middle, Aiden Markram gets surprised but does well to duck under it.
Avesh Khan serves this a touch fuller and on the fifth stump line, holds its line, Aiden Markram leaves it alone.
Length again and on off, Aiden Markram taps it towards point.
This is back of a length and around off, Reeza Hendricks punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Floated up around the pads, Aiden Markram nudges it towards mid-wicket. At the end of the first Powerplay, South Africa are 40/2!
Aiden Markram comes out to the middle now.

OUT! LBW! A maiden ODI wicket for Shahbaz Ahmed and South Africa lose their second wicket inside the first Powerplay. This is served on a nagging length, around middle and just flighted a bit. Janneman Malan looks to block off the front foot but the ball just turns away ever so slightly and beats the bat, hitting the pads. There is a huge appeal for lbw from the bowler and the keeper but the umpire remains unmoved. Shikhar Dhawan eventually goes for the review. The third umpire checks UltraEdge first and there's clearly no bat involved. Ball Tracking then comes up with three reds and the Indian players are elated as the decision is reversed. A brilliant review from India.
Ahmed keeps it full and bowls it around the toes, Reeza Hendricks whips it to the man at deep mid-wicket for one more.
Easy single. Fuller and around middle, Janneman Malan just punches it towards mid on and sets off for the quick single.
Darted in on leg stump, Hendricks pushes it towards wide mid on and rotates the strike.
Flatter delivery, angling onto the pads, Malan goes on the back foot and eases it through mid-wicket for a run.
Length this time, slower in pace and angling into middle and leg. Hendricks keeps it out to the right of the bowler.
This is banged in halfway down the track and outside off. Hendricks looks to pull but the ball keeps low and he is well beaten.
Nicely timed but straight to the fielder. Full and wide, Hendricks drives it towards cover.
Perfect length and top of the off stump line, Hendricks is happy to just block it back to the bowler.
Avesh hits the length hard and bowls it around off, Hendricks stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
Good length, at 141 clicks and outside off, Malan plays it on the up and to the right of third man for a single.
Slides one onto the pads, Hendricks looks to flick it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. A tidy over from Shahbaz Ahmed, just 2 off it.
On off, firmly punched off the middle of the bat towards long off and Malan gets a single.
Pulls back the length a touch and bowls it on off stump. Janneman Malan just about manages to keep it out.
Just slows it up a touch and bowls it around middle. Malan defends it off the back foot.
Length, on off and this is knocked down to long off for a single.
Nagging length, around middle, Reeza Hendricks just blocks it from inside the crease.

FOUR! A couple of poor deliveries to end the over by Avesh Khan. This is full and attacking the pads, Malan is able to get the front leg out of the way and flicks it in front of mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Swung away! Short and wide, shaping away, Janneman Malan stands tall and throws his hands at it. The ball flies over point and goes into the fence.
On a good length, outside off, Malan walks towards the ball and just dabs it down towards point.
A bumper now from Khan, bowled around off and at a good height as well. Malan let's it through to the keeper.
Length ball, around off, this is hit on the up but straight towards mid off.
This is bowled on a fuller length and around off, Janneman Malan strokes it towards mid off.
WIDE! Avesh Khan starts off with a loosener. This is full and well wide outside off, called a wide.
Avesh Khan comes into the attack now.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed down to long off for a single.
Angling it into middle and leg, Malan blocks it off the front foot.
Quicker and flatter, at 102 clicks. Malan taps it towards cover-point.
FOUR! Stunning timing on that occasion. This is fired in around off, Janneman Malan uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and then just punches it into the vacant extra cover fence.
Flatter and angling into middle and leg, Malan defends it out.
On a nagging length, darted into off stump, Janneman Malan keeps it out on the off side using soft hands.
FOUR! Nice shot! Mohammed Siraj lands this short of a length and around middle and leg, Reeza Hendricks ducks a bit but still manages to pull it away towards the deep square leg fence for a boundary.
Lovely shape from Siraj! He bowls this on a good length and just outisde off, shaping away sharply, Reeza Hendricks leaves it alone.
Siraj serves this full again and on off, Janneman Malan drives it towards cover where the fielder fumbles and allows the batter a single.
Goes fuller and on middle, Janneman Malan drills it but straight to mid on.

FOUR! A fine shot but the fielding could have been better there. Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a good length and around off, Janneman Malan moves back and punches it past the diving coevr fielder for a boundary. The fielder got one hand over the ball but fails to stop it and Siraj is not a happy man.
This is pitched up, on middle, angling in, Janneman Malan knocks it towards mid on.
Nicely tossed up, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks pushes it back to the bowler. Just the three singles off Ahmed's first over in ODI cricket.
Darted full and down the leg stump line, Janneman Malan eases it towards long on for one.
Flatter, short and on off, Reeza Hendricks moves back and forces it down to long off for a run and gets off the mark.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Reeza Hendricks blocks it out.
Shortish and on middle, Janneman Malan goes on his back foot and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Shahbaz Ahmed starts with a flighted delivery, full and on off, Janneman Malan drives it but straight to covers.
Shahbaz Ahmed, the debutant comes on as first change.
On a length and around off, angling in, Reeza Hendricks defends it out solidly. Tight bowling from Mohammed Siraj.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Reeza Hendricks blocks it down the pitch.
Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a hard length around the sixth stump line, shaping away, Reeza Hendricks lets it through to the keeper.
Siraj goes a bit wide of the crease and angles in a yorker on middle and leg. Reeza Hendricks jams it out towards mid on.
Fullish length, in that channel around off and nipping away off the deck. Reeza Hendricks watchfully leaves it alone.
Reeza Hendricks walks in at number 3.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Mohammed Siraj strikes and India draw first blood! Siraj comes over the wicket and bowls this on a good length and outside off, angling away, Quinton de Kock stays in crease and tries to reach for it and drive it away without much footwork. He only manages to get an inside edge back onto the stumps. It was a lazy shot from de Kock and he paid the price. South Africa lose their first wicket.
Flighted delivery, full and around off, Janneman Malan goes for the drive but slices it uppishly towards point.
A full toss and on middle and leg, Quinton de Kock tucks it away nicely wide of mid on where Shardul Thakur moves to his left and dives to stop it. They cross.
A bit short and on middle, Janneman Malan moves back and pushes it towards long on for a single and gets off the mark.
Three dots in a row! This is looped up, full and around off, Janneman Malan leans on and knocks it towards covers.
Floated, full and on off, Janneman Malan taps this towards point.
Washington Sundar starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on off, Janneman Malan blocks it to the off side.
Washington Sundar, the off-spinner to take the other new ball.
Another full delivery and on off, Quinton de Kock mistimes his drive towards mid on.
Mohammed Siraj serves this a touch fuller and on leg, swinging in a bit, Quinton de Kock looks to work it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down.
Mohammed Siraj bowls this on a good-length and outside off, angling away, Quinton de Kock leans on and leaves it alone.

Mohammed Siraj contiues to bowl full here, on the pads this time, Quinton de Kock leaves it but it goes off the pads and past the diving Sanju Samson behind the stumps towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. However, the umpire signals dead ball as no shot was offered and it will be a dot ball.
Full again and on middle, Quinton de Kock tucks it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Mohammed Siraj loses his line and serves this full and down the leg, Quinton de Kock misses his flick. Wided.

FOUR! South Africa and Quinton de Kock are underway in some style! Mohammed Siraj starts with a full delivery and around off, Quinton de Kock stays there and gently drives it down the ground for a boundary. A beautiful way to start.

We are ready for play! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the Indian players. Quinton de Kock and Janneman Malan are the openers for South Africa. There is a bit of chat going on between Shikhar Dhawan and de Kock, not sure what's it about but the umpire steps in and the confusion is cleared. Mohammed Siraj has been handed the new ball and is raring to go. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - Deep Dasgupta is pitchside. He says that it isn't the biggest ground and the square boundaries are 60 meters. Ajit Agarkar joins him and says that it is a warm afternoon and it does get cooler and there's not much grass on it. Adds that there might be reverse swing later on and there will be dew coming in too.

Shikhar Dhawan, the captain of India says that they would have batted second. Adds that they want to chase and take advantage of the dew factor in the second innings. Informs they have also made two changes. Washington Sundar and Shahbaz Ahmed comes in for Ruturaj Gaikwad and Ravi Bishnoi.

Keshav Maharaj, the stand in skipper of South Africa says they will have a bat first because it looks like a good wicket and will try to put runs on the board and then restrict the opposition. Informs that Temba Bavuma and Tabraiz Shamsi aren't feeling well today and they will be replaced by Reeza Hendricks and Bjorn Fortuin. Ends by saying that the wicket does look good.

India (Playing XI) - Shikhar Dhawan (C), Shubman Gill, Ishan Kishan (WK), Shreyas Iyer, Sanju Samson, Washington Sundar (In for Ruturaj Gaikwad), Shahbaz Ahmed (In for Ravi Bishnoi & On Debut), Shardul Thakur, Kuldeep Yadav, Avesh Khan, Mohammed Siraj.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Janneman Malan, Quinton de Kock (WK), Reeza Hendricks (In for Temba Bavuma), Aiden Markram, Heinrich Klaasen, David Miller, Wayne Parnell, Keshav Maharaj (C), Kagiso Rabada, Bjorn Fortuin (In for Tabraiz Shamsi) and  Anrich Nortje (In for Lungi Ngidi).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of South Africa. They have elected to BAT first.
The news from the Indian camp is that Shahbaz Ahmed will be making his ODI debut in this match.
